text:
maria.k: Kicking off ZA1 (South Africa) GPU project 'nexus' prep. Need cloud account + VNet scaffold, quota requests, and a quick cost/availability sanity check. Start here and I'll consolidate for handoff to ops.

kevin_r: Thanks — can you paste the desired CIDR and expected GPU SKUs? I can check quotas and SKU availability in the provider.

maria.k: Target CIDR 10.84.0.0/16 to keep consistent with our non-overlap plan. We'll start with a single prod cluster (8x H100 equivalent or A100 if H100 not available) and a small dev pool (2x A10G).

ajay: Heads-up: A100 capacity in ZA1 looks constrained this quarter. I'll open a quota + capacity reservation request. If H100 is available, prefer it for inference perf; otherwise we fallback to A100-80.

netops-bot: @maria.k created ticket #INFRA-4382: "ZA1 capacity & quota request" — assign to kevin_r. SLA: 72h.

kevin_r: I'll start quota request and ping partner rep. For networking: recommend 3 subnets - public (nat/gw), infra (jumpboxes, bastion), compute (pods + kube nodes). Recommend /24 each from the /16.

sonya: For security/compliance — we need an HSM-backed KMS in region or a controlled key in the nearest allowed region. Also enable VPC flow logs and private endpoint for control plane.

maria.k: Good call. Add KMS key option: customer-managed key in ZA1 if supported, otherwise key in eu-west with strict egress rules. Also we require VPC flow logs to log-bucket in secure org account.

ajay: Can someone run our IP-conflict check against existing peering table? I don't want accidental overlap with partner networks. Command: `./tools/netops-check --cidr 10.84.0.0/16 --region za1`

kevin_r: Ran netops-check — returned a warning: potential overlap with partner-telemetry 10.84.128.0/24 via peer in eu-west. Suggest shifting to 10.85.0.0/16 or carve out different /16.

maria.k: Ugh. OK we can move to 10.85/16. I'll update doc. Keep other recommendations the same.

devx-sam: For terraform scaffold, use this snippet for VNet and subnets: ```hcl
resource "azurerm_virtual_network" "za1_vnet" {
  name = "rwd-za1-vnet"
  address_space = ["10.85.0.0/16"]
  location = "southafrica-north"
}
resource "azurerm_subnet" "compute" {
  name = "compute"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.za1_vnet.name
  address_prefixes = ["10.85.16.0/24"]
}
```

sonya: Add NSG rules: block 0.0.0.0/0 ingress except LB IPs, allow management from corp bastion CIDR, and ensure outbound to our telemetry endpoints.

ajay: Cost quick math: H100 equiv on-demand in ZA region ~ $12/hr (rough). For 8 nodes ~ $96/hr -> ~ $69k/month running 24/7. Consider reserved or committed use discounts and preemptible capacity for non-critical jobs. I'll model options in spreadsheet and link it.

kevin_r: I'll also check if cloud partner offers a dedicated host SKU or committed reservation that reduces unit cost.

maria.k: Hand-off checklist I'm expecting: cloud account + billing set, VNet + subnets + NSGs, KMS key or KMS plan, quota & capacity ticket filed, terraform scaffold merged, service accounts & least-priv roles, peering + routing validated, observability sinks (flow logs, metrics, logs) created, and smoke cluster deployed.

devx-sam: Suggest adding a small smoke terraform apply pipeline job: `rwd-ci apply --workspace za1-smoke` that launches 1 node, runs readiness probes, and tears down. Keeps costs low while testing.

netops-bot: INFRA-4382 updated: quota request submitted to partner rep; expected response 48-72h.

sonya: Also add audit logging retention policy and legal-ops contact in the runbook — ZA has data residency considerations.

maria.k: Great. I'll update the runbook with the new CIDR (10.85.0.0/16), add the terraform snippet and the handoff checklist, and tag everyone for review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
